import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('mis_apr_sep_2025.xlsx', sheet_name='Jun')
print(df)
villages = df[df['Village'] "'!= '"'TOTAL']
total = int(villages['Households reached'].sum())
print()
print('Villages counted:', len(villages))
print('Sum of households reached (Jun):', total)
print('TOTAL row value:', int(df.loc[df['Village']=='TOTAL','Households reached'].iloc[0]))
\""
